project_info.theme: Techcombank Priority Visa Signature Asia travel cashback offer
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, white, black, champagne gold, soft gray

main_subject.detail: A clean premium travel-card poster featuring the Techcombank Priority Visa Signature card standing vertically in the center. Large Vietnamese headline text reads 'Vi vu A Chau - Khong lo ve phi' and 'Hoan toi 7 trieu VND', followed by 'khi thanh toan the Techcombank priority Visa Signature'. Around the card are iconic Asia-travel landmarks including Marina Bay Sands, a traditional palace gate, a snow mountain resembling Mount Fuji, the Shanghai Oriental Pearl Tower skyline, and a large white airplane flying across the bottom foreground. Bottom right has a rounded badge reading 'Dinh hinh PHONG CACH SONG'.
main_subject.style: Premium travel banking poster with glossy card rendering, airy destination collage, and luxury lifestyle visual tone
